nodes.summary: Let $G$ be a finite group, let $O(G)$, the odd core of $G$, be the subgroup generated by all normal subgroups of $G$ of odd order, let $n \ge 3$, and let $P$ be a Sylow $2$-subgroup of $G$ isomorphic to the generalized quaternion group $Q_{2^n}$ of order $2^n$. If $t \in P$ has order $2$, then the image of $t$ in $G / O(G)$ lies in the center of $G / O(G)$.
nodes.title: Brauer–Suzuki theorem

nodes.summary: The odd core $O(G)$ of a group $G$ is the supremum, in the lattice of subgroups of $G$, of all normal subgroups of $G$ whose order is finite and odd.
nodes.title: Odd core of a group
